description: The tasks in one pipeline: with no since, the ones that are not done; with since (milliseconds), the ones HubSpot changed after it, oldest first. Each carries task_id, title, notes, status (open, doing or done), assignee, due and updated_at. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /hubspot/v1/connections/{connection_id}/projects/{project_id}/tasks, group hubspot.

connection_id.description: Value for the {connection_id} segment of /hubspot/v1/connections/{connection_id}/projects/{project_id}/tasks. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

project_id.description: Value for the {project_id} segment of /hubspot/v1/connections/{connection_id}/projects/{project_id}/tasks. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
